title: The performance fee is charged when the price falls
rootCause: FeeManager.calculateFee charges the performance fee when the reported price is below the stored minimum, and updateState keeps the lowest price seen, so every new low mints fee shares and a rising price mints none.

poc.observable: test_a_falling_price_charges_no_performance_fee fails with "the performance fee when the price falls by a tenth: 10000000000000000000 != 0"
